notes.title: December 2024 - Update 1.0.42
notes.notes:
[FIX]
- Fixed an incorrect reward value after defeating the Kraken.
- Fixed an issue where some crafting units did not save their enabled state after reloading the game.
- Resolved an issue where some achievements did not unlock for games migrated from the demo.
- Fixed an issue where a villager was consumed even when the player canceled military production.

[ENH]
- Adjusted the position of resource gain numbers.
- Added instructions showing that the game can be played as a clicker game.
- Added details on how to use Priests.

[BALANCE]
- Buffed regular upgrades.
- Workers will no longer reset after applying prestige perks.
- Reduced rewards from the Kraken.


A Message from the Developer

If you enjoyed playing the game, I’d greatly appreciate it if you could take a moment to write a review and recommend it to others. As a solo indie developer, your reviews mean the world to me and are vital for the game's success!

Hello Folks,

First of all, thank you very much for your priceless feedback! I’ll do my best to implement most of your suggestions. This update is a test to see if you prefer a more active gameplay alternative for the game.

Let me know if you need any further changes or adjustments!
